mainEntity.name: Can my mother or sister perform pind daan, or must it be the son?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditionally, the eldest son performs. However, modern practice allows daughters or other female relatives to perform if there's no son. The ritual's validity comes from loving intention and proper procedure, not the performer's gender.

mainEntity.name: What if I don't know my ancestors' exact names?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pandit will work with you. He'll ask your father's full name, grandfather's name, and as far back as you know. The Sankalp can include 'all known and unknown ancestors' if genealogy is unclear.

mainEntity.name: Is there a risk the pandit will cheat me?

acceptedAnswer.text: With our verified pandits, no. They have reputations spanning 20-30 years and are embedded in the temple authority system. We document the ritual and stay connected—any post-ritual complaints are addressed immediately.

mainEntity.name: Can I do pind daan for my mother or both parents together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Multiple ancestors can be included in one day's ritual. The pandit creates separate pind for each. Cost increases slightly for materials and time, but it's the same ritual procedure.

mainEntity.name: What if I perform pind daan and later learn the pandit wasn't legitimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: We refund 100% of priest fees and arrange a repeat ritual with a verified Gayawal Panda at no additional cost. We guarantee legitimacy.

mainEntity.name: Is it wrong to perform pind daan outside Pitru Paksha?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pitru Paksha is optimal, but not mandatory. Pind daan can be performed anytime during the year. It's less powerful outside the Paksha window according to tradition, but it's still valid.

mainEntity.name: How much does pind daan cost in Gaya 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard pind daan for 1-3 ancestors costs ₹4,350-6,300 total including pandit dakshina, temple fees, materials, Gayawal Panda registration, and transport. Extended packages for 5+ ancestors range from ₹10,850-23,300.
Pitru Paksha 2026 runs from September 7-21. The most auspicious time (Kutup Muhurat) is September 21 from 11:47 AM - 12:37 PM.

mainEntity.name: What should I wear for pind daan?

acceptedAnswer.text: White dhoti/kurta (traditional), no leather, no shoes during ritual. If you don't own a dhoti, we can arrange rental for ₹100-200 from Gaya shops.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I get emotional during the ritual?

acceptedAnswer.text: This is expected and honored. The pandit trains for this. Take all the time you need. There's no schedule. Tears are part of the ritual's sacredness.

mainEntity.name: Can NRIs perform pind daan via live video if they cannot travel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer live video coordination for NRIs who cannot travel. You participate via WhatsApp/Zoom, see the entire ritual in real-time, and give verbal sankalp. However, being present in person is traditionally more powerful.

mainEntity.name: Can I perform pind daan multiple times for the same ancestor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditionally, once is sufficient and complete. However, performing annually on the ancestor's death anniversary is common and spiritually beneficial.
